authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India

description.en: Jeevan Pramaan is the Aadhaar-based Digital Life Certificate for pensioners. It eliminates the need for pensioners to physically present themselves before the pension disbursing authority or a certifying authority to obtain a life certificate. The biometric digital life certificate is generated using Aadhaar authentication and is electronically transmitted to the pension disbursing agency.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: All pensioners requiring annual life certificate
verifiedConditions.claim: Jeevan Pramaan is available to all pensioners who receive pension from the Central Government, State Government, EPFO, or any other pension disbursing agency that accepts Jeevan Pramaan as a valid life certificate.
Aadhaar number linked with the pensioner's biometrics is mandatory for generating a Jeevan Pramaan Digital Life Certificate, as the certificate is generated through Aadhaar biometric authentication.

unverifiedEligibility: Family pensioners may also use Jeevan Pramaan if their pension disbursing agency accepts it.
Pensioners whose biometrics are not captured in Aadhaar (e.g., due to age-related fingerprint degradation) may use face authentication or iris authentication.
Some pension disbursing agencies may not yet accept Jeevan Pramaan; pensioners should verify with their disbursing agency.

requirements.claim: Aadhaar number of the pensioner is mandatory. The Aadhaar must be linked with the pensioner's biometric data for authentication.

Pension Payment Order (PPO) number and pension disbursing agency details (bank name and branch, or treasury/AG office) are required to link the digital life certificate with the correct pension account.
Mobile number linked with Aadhaar is required for OTP-based verification during the Jeevan Pramaan generation process.

A biometric device (fingerprint scanner or iris scanner) connected to a smartphone or computer is required for Aadhaar biometric authentication. Alternatively, face authentication is available on supported smartphones through the Jeevan Pramaan app.

processInformation.appliesTo: Pensioners using the mobile app method
processInformation.claim: Download the Jeevan Pramaan mobile application from Google Play Store (Android) or Apple App Store (iOS). The app is also available as a desktop application for Windows.
Enter the Aadhaar number, pension account details (PPO number, pension disbursing agency, bank name and branch), mobile number, and email address in the Jeevan Pramaan application.
Perform Aadhaar biometric authentication using fingerprint, iris, or face recognition. The system verifies the pensioner's identity against the Aadhaar database through UIDAI authentication services.

Upon successful biometric authentication, a Digital Life Certificate is generated with a unique Pramaan ID. The certificate is stored on the Jeevan Pramaan server and electronically transmitted to the pension disbursing agency.

An SMS and email confirmation are sent to the pensioner with the Pramaan ID. The pensioner can also download the certificate from the Jeevan Pramaan portal using the Pramaan ID. The pension disbursing agency receives the certificate directly.

output.claim: A Digital Life Certificate with a unique Pramaan ID is generated and electronically transmitted to the pension disbursing agency. The certificate confirms that the pensioner is alive and serves as a valid life certificate for pension continuity. It can be downloaded as a PDF from the Jeevan Pramaan portal.

fees.claim: Jeevan Pramaan Digital Life Certificate is completely free of cost. No government fee or service charge is applicable for generating the digital life certificate.

processingTime.applicability: Jeevan Pramaan generation upon successful biometric authentication
processingTime.claim: The Digital Life Certificate is generated instantly upon successful Aadhaar biometric authentication. The certificate is immediately stored on the Jeevan Pramaan server and transmitted to the pension disbursing agency, typically within the same day.

sources.title: Jeevan Pramaan — Digital Life Certificate Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: The Jeevan Pramaan portal is the official platform for generating Aadhaar-based Digital Life Certificates for pensioners. It provides the mobile app, desktop app, and operator-assisted facility for biometric authentication and certificate generation.
claimsSupported: Jeevan Pramaan is Aadhaar-based digital life certificate for pensioners.
Available for Central Government, State Government, and EPFO pensioners.
Requires Aadhaar, PPO number, and biometric authentication.
Certificate generated instantly upon successful authentication.
Mobile app available for Android and iOS.
Face authentication supported on newer smartphones.
sources.uncertainty: Not all pension disbursing agencies may accept Jeevan Pramaan; acceptance depends on the agency's integration with the system.

sources.title: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology — Jeevan Pramaan Initiative
sources.publisher: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: MeitY administers the Jeevan Pramaan initiative as a Digital India program. The initiative aims to simplify the life certificate process for pensioners through Aadhaar-based biometric authentication.
claimsSupported: Jeevan Pramaan is a MeitY initiative under Digital India.
Biometric device or face authentication required for certificate generation.
Certificate electronically transmitted to pension disbursing agency.
sources.uncertainty: MeitY provides the technology platform; pension processing remains the responsibility of individual disbursing agencies.

limitations: Not all pension disbursing agencies may accept Jeevan Pramaan; pensioners should verify acceptance with their specific disbursing agency.
Pensioners with Aadhaar biometric issues (fingerprint degradation due to age, manual labor, or medical conditions) may face authentication failures; face authentication may help in such cases.
The record does not cover the manual life certificate process which remains available for pensioners unable to use Jeevan Pramaan.
Operator-assisted facility availability at Common Service Centres and bank branches is not fully modeled.
The integration status of Jeevan Pramaan with specific state government pension systems is not covered.

review.reviewReason: Core Jeevan Pramaan process is reviewed, but agency-specific acceptance and integration status are not fully verified.
